title: Kevin Rue-Albrecht
text:
Kevin Rue-Albrecht


         




I am a computational biologist and biomedical data science trainer at the University of Oxford, with a focus on functional genomics and single-cell sequencing.
I actively collaborate on a range of research projects, predominantly applying single-cell analysis to diverse biological questions.
Inspiration from these collaborations drives my development of research software, with a particular emphasis on interactive data visualisation.
I am also an active contributor to the Bioconductor project, where I develop and maintain R packages together with the community.

title: Software
text: My research and development work has resulted in various software packages, primarily focused on bioinformatics and data visualisation.

title: Software
text:
iSEE Ecosystem
The iSEE (Interactive SummarizedExperiment Explorer) ecosystem provides a framework for interactive visualisation of genomics data.
I have collaboratively developed and maintain the core iSEE package along with several extension packages in the Bioconductor project.


iSEE
Core framework for interactive visualisation of genomics data.

   
 



iSEEindex
Portal for multiple data sets in a single interface.

 




iSEEde
Differential expression visualisation panels.

 




iSEEpathways
Pathway analysis visualisation panels.

 




iSEEhex
Panels specialised in hexagonal binning.

 




iSEEhub
Portal for the Bioconductor ExperimentHub data resources.

 




iSEEu
The “iSEE universe”. Goal: a wrapper for all iSEE extensions, like the tidyverse. For now, a collection of miscellaneous panels and “modes”.

 





 For more information and links to third-party extensions, please visit the iSEE website.
